description: Two anti-aliased oscillators sharing one master pitch, each able to sync the other at a set probability and to randomise its own cycle length

params.text: Sets the octave of the master pitch for both oscillators, C0 to C8, with position 4 giving C4 at 261.63Hz
Transposes both oscillators by seven semitones either way, in semitone steps
Transposes both oscillators anywhere within a semitone either way
Offsets oscillator B from the master pitch, one octave down to four octaves up, a frequency ratio of a half to sixteen times
Attenuates and inverts the EXP A input; the setting is cubed, and at full clockwise one volt there moves oscillator A by about one octave
Attenuates and inverts the LIN A input; the setting is cubed, and at full clockwise one volt there shifts oscillator A by about 1600Hz
Attenuates and inverts the EXP B input; the setting is cubed, and at full clockwise one volt there moves oscillator B by about one octave
Attenuates and inverts the LIN B input; the setting is cubed, and at full clockwise one volt there shifts oscillator B by about 1600Hz
Randomises the length of every cycle of oscillator A, from none at fully counter-clockwise to a whole cycle either way at fully clockwise, which turns its sawtooth into noise
The probability that oscillator A is restarted at each cycle end of oscillator B, from never at fully counter-clockwise to every time at fully clockwise; it starts fully counter-clockwise
Randomises the length of every cycle of oscillator B, from none at fully counter-clockwise to a whole cycle either way at fully clockwise, which turns its sawtooth into noise
The probability that oscillator B is restarted at each cycle end of oscillator A, from never at fully counter-clockwise to every time at fully clockwise; it starts fully clockwise, which is hard sync
Attenuates and inverts the CHS A input, and at full clockwise ten volts there moves the chaos of oscillator A across its whole range
Attenuates and inverts the SNC A input, and at full clockwise ten volts there moves the sync probability of oscillator A across its whole range
Attenuates and inverts the CHS B input, and at full clockwise ten volts there moves the chaos of oscillator B across its whole range
Attenuates and inverts the SNC B input, and at full clockwise ten volts there moves the sync probability of oscillator B across its whole range

inputs.text: Exponential frequency modulation of oscillator A, scaled by the EXP FM A knob
Through-zero linear frequency modulation of oscillator A, scaled by the LIN FM A knob; with nothing patched here no linear FM is applied to oscillator A
Exponential frequency modulation of oscillator B, scaled by the EXP FM B knob
Through-zero linear frequency modulation of oscillator B, scaled by the LIN FM B knob; with nothing patched here no linear FM is applied to oscillator B
Added to the CHAOS A setting, scaled by the CHS A attenuverter
Added to the SYNC A setting, scaled by the SNC A attenuverter
Added to the CHAOS B setting, scaled by the CHS B attenuverter
Added to the SYNC B setting, scaled by the SNC B attenuverter
A rising edge restarts oscillator A at the start of its cycle
A rising edge restarts oscillator B at the start of its cycle
Master pitch for oscillator A, one volt per octave, added to the pitch set by OCTAVE, COARSE and FINE
Pitch for oscillator B, one volt per octave; with nothing patched here oscillator B takes the pitch of oscillator A, exponential FM included, and RATIO B on top

outputs.text: The sawtooth of oscillator A, -5V to 5V, with its level corrected for the CHAOS A setting
The square of oscillator A, one octave below its sawtooth, -5V to 5V
The sawtooth of oscillator B, -5V to 5V, with its level corrected for the CHAOS B setting
The square of oscillator B, one octave below its sawtooth, -5V to 5V

notes: the two sync knobs come up with oscillator A never synced and oscillator B synced every cycle, so the module sounds as a hard-synced pair until those knobs are moved
there is no menu of this module's own beyond Rack's; every setting is on the panel
